description: This PHP script facilitates creating a test suite via the XMLRPC API in the TestLink project management tool. It constructs argument arrays, initiates an XMLRPC client call, and handles the response by setting environment variables or throwing exceptions upon failure.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: An external XMLRPC client class used to communicate with the API server.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: External function that executes an XMLRPC test call with the provided client, method, arguments, and index.
